bayts.text: And spare us, by the alif of the formula of refuge, from that against which refuge is sought, O my Refuge.
Spare us, by its ʿayn, from every accursed one and from all that You are not pleased with for me, O Helper.
Spare us, by its wāw, from every crookedness, and free us from what brings on retaliation.
Spare us, by the dhāl, from every humiliation, and free us from the unlawful through the lawful.
And enrich us with Allah above all else, with all that we love for His Face.
And by the remaining letters grant us a grace for which those before us will (holily) envy us.
And grant us, by the right of the bāʾ of the basmala, the sīn and the mīm, the joy of the perfect.
And grant us, by the bāʾ, in the two Abodes, what wards off the two shames and the two fires.
And grant us, by its sīn, felicity, in the present and in what is to come, and the wonder that breaks custom.
Grant us, by its mīm, a dominion that gladdens, and through what is easy free us from what is hard.
And grant us, by the alif, pliancy without disobedience, and illumine the place of my intimacy.
Grant us, by the lām, an immediate kindness, with glad tidings, and a kindness to come.
You have already led me, by the hidden alif, to the attainment of the lofty stations through the folding (of distances).
So bless for ever, with a peace without end, a Prophet who has been accepted,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, on my behalf, and answer my request.
By the sanctity of the impregnable formula of refuge, bless him who brought the Law (Sharīʿa),
our master Muḥammad, and grant him peace, and the Family, the Companions and every Muslim.
And free me from need of (other) formulas of protection, O One in His attribute and in Essence
and in His works; and grant me protection from harm and from every stain.
By the sanctity of the blessed basmala, O You to Whom creation belongs without partnership,
bless and grant peace for ever, O Allah, upon our Prophet and whoever has taken him as friend,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, O You to Whom is my return.
And grant me in You the perpetuity of blessing, without any man or woman who associates partners.
And by it free me thus from (having to say) "give me", and spare my every direction what is not glad tidings.
And bless for me all movements and stillnesses, and make them blessings.
O You with Whom I have sought refuge from Iblīs and from everything that holds ruin,
to You my gratitude, after an everlasting praise, O Exalted above son and father.
Send Satan toward a direction other than mine, and tame for me, in my homeland, (other) homelands.
